task.title: Is each statement supported by the passage?
task.description: Read one passage and decide, for each short statement, whether the passage supports it. 11 tabs per HIT.

question.text: Is this statement supported by the passage above?

instructions.summary: Your task is to decide whether each statement is supported by the passage shown with it.
instructions.background: A search system retrieved passages for a question, and short statements were written as an answer to that question. We want to know which statements each passage actually supports.

criteria.label: Grounded
criteria.text: You can confirm the statement is true using only the information in the passage. Paraphrases and synonyms count; exact wording is not required.

criteria.label: Not grounded
criteria.text: The passage does not contain enough information to confirm the statement, or it contradicts the statement.

steps: Read the question and the passage in the tab.
For each statement below the passage, decide whether the passage supports it.
Judge each passage on its own. Do not use the other tabs or your own knowledge.
Answer every statement in every tab, then press Submit.
notes: A statement may be supported by several different passages. Judge it again for each passage.
If the passage is about a different topic, every statement in that tab is Not grounded.
instructions.tip: Focus on what the passage says, not on whether the statement is true in the real world.
